entities.name: Joaquín Crespo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joaquín Sinforiano de Jesús Crespo Torres was a Venezuelan military officer and politician. A member of the Great Liberal Party of Venezuela, he served as the president of Venezuela from 1884 to 1886 and again from 1892 to 1898. He began his career as a soldier during the Federal War.
